questions.question: In your own words, using the example of a taxi fare, explain what inflation is.
questions.expected_answer: Inflation is when the price of everyday things, like a taxi fare, goes up and stays up over time, meaning your money buys less than it used to.

questions.question: Why does Stats SA use a 'basket of goods' to measure the CPI instead of just checking the price of one item?
questions.expected_answer: They use a basket of goods to measure the 'general price level'—representing what an average household buys—because inflation affects the entire economy, not just a single product.
